summary.what_it_does:
The page describes Stockimg as an all-in-one design and content creation tool powered by AI. It says users can generate logos, illustrations, wallpapers, posters, and other visual content. It also says users can connect social media accounts and schedule posts with AI, and that it can generate and schedule content for social media. The page includes a 'Generate Post' heading and a free trial prompt, but gives no detail on specific models, editing options, or export formats.</what_it_does>
